response.sql: WITH station_usage AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS mean_usage FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation HAVING COUNT(bandusagepct) > 0), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(mean_usage) AS overall_mean FROM station_usage) SELECT AVG(s.mean_usage) AS mean_bandwidth_usage, AVG(s.mean_usage - b.overall_mean) AS mean_above_average FROM station_usage AS s CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE s.mean_usage > b.overall_mean;
